title: Caro-Kann Defence
intro: 1.e4 c6 and 2...d5: as solid as the French, but the light-squared bishop gets out before ...e6.

lessons.title: The Classical Caro-Kann
lessons.summary: Bishop out to f5, then a rock-solid position.

steps.text: Against 1.e4, the Caro-Kann plays 1...c6 to prepare ...d5. Unlike the French, the bishop on c8 is not shut in.

steps.hint: The d-pawn two squares, supported by c6.
steps.ifWrong: Strike at e4 with the d-pawn.

steps.ifRight: White will take back with the knight.

steps.text: Develop the bishop outside your pawn chain, attacking the knight.
steps.hint: Your light-squared bishop can hit e4.
steps.ifWrong: The Classical line brings the bishop to f5.
steps.ifRight: An active bishop. Next comes ...e6 behind it.

steps.text: White attacks your bishop with 5.Ng3. Keep it on the same diagonal.
steps.hint: Step back one square along the diagonal.
steps.ifWrong: Keep the bishop on the b1-h7 diagonal: retreat to g6.
steps.ifRight: The bishop stays active, and it is safe on g6.
